todos.task: Develop a comprehensive list of potential breach scenarios to simulate and test the crisis management plan
Conduct simulated breach exercises to identify gaps and areas for improvement in the plan
Analyze the results of the simulated breach exercises and gather feedback from stakeholders
Revise and refine the crisis management plan based on the findings and feedback from the simulated breach exercises
Schedule regular review and update cycles to ensure the plan remains relevant and effective
Implement a system to track and document changes to the plan and maintain a record of updates and revisions
